Name: Xtarfur Valley
Author: zellgoma
Description:
[s]This world requires me to work, so the mod isn't going to be able to be updated.
[/s]Anyone can claim my work and expand, if you want! Though I'd recommend asking
xtardew creator and the anthro characters continued creators as well! I did when I made this.


If you're a degenerate like me, you love furs and lewd stuff! Well this mod is designed to make the mod https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083 (Anthro Characters Continued) compatible with the mod https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399 (Xtardew Valley)!
Please keep in mind that you need both of those packs, as well as all their requirements for this to work correctly. :3




Sprites and portraits originally created by the amazing Pseudodiego: https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/1706874-pseudodiego/ and Gavelly (Twitter: @Gavelly)
